title: SEKA Spear Standard owner build after 18 months
notes: Owner lists a Spear Standard frame in Achromatic Silver (素银), size L, after about 18 months of riding: Shimano 105 Di2 R7170 groupset with a Dura-Ace chain, 50-34 chainrings, Voso Ultimate 50 Ultra wheels, Continental GP5000 STR 28 mm tubeless tyres and a Rapier 40-100 bar. The owner states the bike has stayed at 7.5 kg; pedals, computer and power-meter inclusion are not stated. Components are the owner's choices.
